title: AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning
abstract: Language model agents increasingly automate post-training, but when given the full training stack they converge on supervised fine-tuning and spend most effort revising training data. Existing systems give the agent one kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator, whereas a human data engineer adjusts proportions, prunes, repairs, replaces and synthesizes the data. We design a data action space for these changes and ask whether an automated system can make the full range rather than one of them, and what structure that requires. We first run this loop with a single agent, and it reaches only one action, adjusting category proportions, while its context fills with execution output and is discarded mid-search. We therefore introduce \textbf{AutoSFT}, a multi-agent system where a meta agent separates execution from analysis, gathers proposals from independent angles, and calls a synthesis subagent for capabilities the pool cannot cover, with the model, the trainer, and the budget fixed within each comparison. Adding each component in turn helps: the executor halves context loss, the analysis subagents lift the best IFEval by $+6.5$, and synthesis adds $+3.4$ IFEval and $+2.9$ IFBench. The same loop transfers to code, where analysis adds $+3.7$ MBPP+ over a single agent that does not improve. Every result comes from runs that retrain from the base model each round, so each component's effect is individually attributable. Our findings suggest that automating SFT data research depends more on covering diverse data actions than on a stronger single action.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In our hypothetical graduate course, Data-Centric Language Model Research, today's lecture is on Auto S-F-T: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning. Recent work such as PostTrainBench studies whether agents can automate post-training, while R-S-I-Bench-Data evaluates agents as data researchers. This field is moving toward systems that learn from experimental feedback. Researchers at Tsinghua University and ModelBest ask a focused question: can an agent explore data engineering more broadly than simply changing which examples it samples? Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在我们这门假想的研究生课程“以数据为中心的语言模型研究”中，今天的讲座主题是Auto S-F-T：一个用于监督微调中自动化数据研究的智能体系统。近期的工作，比如PostTrainBench，研究的是智能体能否自动化后训练，而R-S-I-Bench-Data则评估智能体作为数据研究者的能力。这个领域正朝着能从实验反馈中学习的系统发展。清华大学和ModelBest的研究人员提出了一个很聚焦的问题：智能体能否比单纯改变采样哪些样本更广泛地探索数据工程？是的，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, why focus on data changes instead of improving the training algorithm?
segments.zh: 教授您好，为什么关注数据改动，而不是改进训练算法呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Because the paper treats data as an experimental object in its own right. In supervised fine-tuning, a dataset’s selection, quality, composition, and ordering can all shape model behavior. Auto S-F-T does not propose a new architecture or optimizer; it builds a research loop for investigating those choices. That focus matters as automated post-training systems become more capable: if agents only repeat one kind of data intervention, they may miss useful alternatives a human data engineer would consider.
segments.zh: 因为这篇论文把数据本身当作实验对象。在监督微调中，数据集的选择、质量、构成和顺序都会影响模型行为。Auto S-F-T 并没有提出新的架构或优化器，而是搭建了一个研究闭环来考察这些选择。随着自动化后训练系统能力越来越强，这一关注点愈发重要：如果智能体只重复一种数据干预，就可能错过人类数据工程师会考虑的有用替代方案。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors organize those alternatives into six action families. Mixture changes the proportions of data groups; pruning removes examples; repair edits flawed examples; resupervision replaces answers while keeping the instructions; synthesis adds new examples; and ordering changes the sequence presented during training. The categories are determined by what changes in the data recipe, not just by the agent’s description of its intention. This gives the system a practical vocabulary for exploring distinct interventions.
segments.zh: 作者把这些备选方案归为六类动作。混合是改变各数据组的比例；剪枝是删掉样本；修复是修改有问题的样本；重新监督是保留指令、替换答案；合成是新增样本；排序是改变训练时呈现的顺序。这些类别是根据数据配方中实际改变了什么来划分的，而不只是看智能体怎么描述自己的意图。这就给了系统一套实用的词汇，用来探索不同的干预方式。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: does each experiment build on the model from the previous round?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：每个实验都是在前一轮模型的基础上继续训练的吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. Each round starts again from the same base checkpoint, using a potentially revised data pool and recipe. That is an important control: it helps distinguish the effect of the data changes from accumulated changes in model weights. The training procedure, token budget, and evaluation protocol are held constant within comparisons, while the agent records its hypotheses and outcomes. Think of each round as a fresh trial with a changed recipe, rather than another layer of seasoning added to an evolving dish.
segments.zh: 不是。每一轮都从同一个基础检查点重新开始，使用可能经过修订的数据池和配方。这是一个重要的控制：它有助于把数据变化带来的影响与模型权重累积变化区分开来。在比较中，训练流程、token预算和评估协议保持不变，同时智能体记录它的假设和结果。把每一轮看作一次换了配方的新试验，而不是在一道不断演变的菜上再添一层调味。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The system also separates work across agents. A meta agent coordinates an executor, four analysis agents, and a synthesis agent. The executor runs training and evaluation in a separate session, keeping detailed logs out of the meta agent’s main context. The analysis agents inspect different evidence: data quality and coverage, successes and failures, learning dynamics, and earlier interventions. They return proposals; the meta agent remains responsible for choosing the next recipe.
segments.zh: 系统还把工作拆分给不同的智能体。一个元智能体负责协调一个执行器、四个分析智能体和一个综合智能体。执行器在独立的会话中运行训练和评估，把详细日志挡在元智能体的主上下文之外。分析智能体各自检查不同的证据：数据质量和覆盖度、成功与失败案例、学习动态，以及此前的干预措施。它们返回建议，而元智能体仍然负责选择下一个配方。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does the synthesis agent avoid adding examples that merely look plausible?
segments.zh: 合成智能体如何避免加入那些只是看起来合理的样本？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It uses several checks before generated examples enter the pool. In instruction-following experiments, the system targets capabilities with insufficient representation and can express those targets as verifiable constraints. Each candidate must pass a programmatic verifier, an independent semantic review, and an n-gram overlap check against evaluation data. These safeguards do not guarantee that every example is useful, but they reduce obvious validity and contamination risks. The design treats synthesis as a measured intervention, not an unrestricted stream of generated text.
segments.zh: 它在生成的示例进入池子之前会做几道检查。在指令遵循实验中，系统会针对表示不足的能力，并能把这些目标表达成可验证的约束。每个候选示例都必须通过程序化验证器、独立的语义审查，以及与评估数据的n-gram重叠检查。这些防护措施不能保证每个示例都有用，但能降低明显的有效性和污染风险。这个设计把合成当作一种有节制的干预，而不是一股不受限制的生成文本流。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The first practical insight is that execution overhead can interfere with research decisions. In the pilot, one agent handled data choices, training, evaluation, and interpretation. Its context became crowded with logs and repeated records, and it repeatedly adjusted mixture proportions without repairing, replacing, or generating examples. Adding the separate executor reduced context compactions from ten to five and shell-command events from 58% to 29% over comparable elapsed time. That supports an efficiency claim, not a score-improvement claim.
segments.zh: 第一个实用洞见是，执行开销会干扰研究决策。在试点中，一个智能体包揽了数据选择、训练、评估和解读。它的上下文被日志和重复记录塞满，反复调整混合比例，却没有修复、替换或生成样本。加入独立的执行器后，在相近的耗时内，上下文压缩次数从十次降到五次，shell 命令事件占比从 58% 降到 29%。这支持的是效率提升，而非分数提升。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Wait, did the analysis agents improve results simply by proposing more kinds of actions?
segments.zh: 等等，分析型智能体是不是仅仅靠提出更多种类的动作就提升了结果？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The reported comparison suggests a connection, but it does not isolate every cause. At 30 rounds, the analysis configuration scored 67.10% on I-F-Eval, versus 60.60% for the single-agent configuration at the same round count. Repair and resupervision made up 55% of its actions; the single agent kept using mixture changes. Neither generated examples in this comparison. The result indicates that broader analysis coincided with different interventions and higher scores, but one search per configuration limits causal certainty.
segments.zh: 报告中的对比暗示了一种关联，但并未隔离所有原因。在30轮时，分析配置在I-F-Eval上得分67.10%，而单智能体配置在相同轮数下为60.60%。修复和重新监督占其动作的55%；单智能体则一直使用混合变更。这一对比中两者都没有生成示例。结果表明，更广泛的分析与不同的干预措施和更高的分数同时出现，但每种配置只进行一次搜索限制了因果确定性。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A second insight is that targeted synthesis can address gaps in the available pool. With synthesis, the best I-F-Eval score was 81.58%, compared with 78.15% without it; on I-F-Bench, the corresponding scores were 51.95% and 49.02%. A targeted example set also raised the repeat-prompt capability’s pass rate to 75.6% in one round. Yet odd-even-syllables stayed at zero after being targeted three times, showing that added coverage does not ensure a capability is learnable under the tested conditions.
segments.zh: 第二个洞见是，有针对性的合成可以弥补现有池子里的缺口。用了合成之后，I-F-Eval 的最佳得分是81.58%，不用则是78.15%；在 I-F-Bench 上，对应的得分分别是51.95%和49.02%。一套有针对性的示例集还在某一轮把重复提示能力的通过率提升到了75.6%。但奇偶音节在被针对性处理三次之后仍然为零，说明增加覆盖并不能保证某项能力在测试条件下是可学的。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can we conclude the approach transfers to coding, or are those results too limited?
segments.zh: 我们能就此断定这个方法能迁移到编程任务上吗，还是说这些结果太有限了？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The coding experiment offers a promising test, but not a broad guarantee. On M-B-P-P plus, the single-agent setup showed no sustained improvement; analysis agents reached 64.8% at round 13, and adding synthesis reached 65.8% by round six. The authors report a 3.7-point analysis gain over the single-agent result. Unlike instruction-following, coding lacked a supplied capability breakdown, so the system derived one from observed failures and available data. The runs were short, so transfer remains preliminary.
segments.zh: 编码实验提供了一个有前景的测试，但并不能提供广泛的保证。在M-B-P-P plus上，单智能体设置没有表现出持续改进；分析智能体在第13轮达到64.8%，加入综合后到第六轮达到65.8%。作者报告称，相比单智能体结果，分析带来了3.7个百分点的提升。与指令遵循不同，编码缺少预先提供的能力分解，因此系统从观察到的失败和可用数据中推导出了一份。运行时间较短，所以迁移仍是初步的。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Taken together, Auto S-F-T shifts attention from asking only how an agent trains a model to asking what range of data interventions it can investigate. Its controlled, same-base-model rounds make comparisons more interpretable, and its division of labor helps separate execution from analysis. That perspective connects with PostTrainBench’s study of automated post-training, while adding a specific emphasis on data research. Still, all experiments use one base model at one scale, and repeated evaluations do not replace independent full search runs.
segments.zh: 综合来看，Auto S-F-T把注意力从只问智能体如何训练模型，转向它能研究多大范围的数据干预。它在同一基础模型上进行的受控多轮实验让比较更具可解释性，而其分工方式有助于把执行与分析分开。这一视角与PostTrainBench对自动化后训练的研究相呼应，同时特别强调数据研究。不过，所有实验都只用一个基础模型、一个规模，重复评估并不能替代独立的完整搜索运行。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the key limitation is whether these results hold across models, datasets, and independent searches?
segments.zh: 所以关键局限在于，这些结果能否在不同模型、数据集和独立搜索中都成立？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. The evidence supports feasibility in the reported settings, not universal gains across scales, domains, or budgets. Future work should repeat complete searches, test more models and datasets, and examine which data actions help which capabilities. The memorable takeaway is this: an automated researcher’s progress may depend not just on how well it trains, but on whether it knows how many different questions to ask of its data. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 完全正确。这些证据支持的是在已报告设定下的可行性，而不是跨规模、跨领域或跨预算的普遍收益。未来的工作应该重复完整的搜索过程，测试更多模型和数据集，并研究哪些数据操作有助于哪些能力。值得记住的要点是：一个自动化研究者的进展可能不仅取决于它训练得有多好，还取决于它是否知道该对数据提出多少个不同的问题。感谢收听。如果还有任何问题，可以询问我们的AI助手或留言评论。
